description: We are a team of innovators passionate about technology and science, driven by a desire to pioneer solutions that can make a real difference in the world.
summary: Dust2Farm is a precision-agriculture demo designed to help growers monitor crops and irrigation in water-stressed environments such as Dakhla. Its dashboard brings together parcel visualization, field operations, satellite observations, weather context, and explainable risk indicators. The interactive 3D view presents farm zones, irrigation lines, and sensor conditions. The Dakhla analysis combines historical NASA GPM IMERG rainfall, MERRA-2 meteorology, and PT-JPL evapotranspiration with parcel-level summaries. A Python FastAPI backend serves the data and assesses indicators for tomato air humidity, flow anomalies, leaks, salinity, erosion, and clogging. Missing measurements remain undetermined, helping users see where field checks are needed. The risk engine uses transparent rules and thresholds; it is not yet a trained machine-learning model because confirmed incident labels are unavailable. The project demonstrates how Earth observation and field measurements can support earlier inspections, clearer decisions, and more resilient agriculture. Its architecture can incorporate real sensors, verified maintenance events, and machine learning.
